description: Execute write operations in order, stopping on first failure. Each step is snapshotted and journaled individually. Pass the planFingerprint from plan_changes so the plan is refused (PLAN_STATE_CHANGED) when the configuration it touches changed after the preview — this check applies to every role. Non-admin identities also need a confirmationToken (same two-step flow as other destructive tools), itself bound to the state when issued. Undo individual steps via rollback_change with the returned journal IDs.

planFingerprint.description: The planFingerprint from plan_changes. When given, apply_plan first checks that the steps are the planned ones and that the configuration each step touches is still what plan_changes saw, and refuses with PLAN_STATE_CHANGED if not. Recommended: without it, the plan runs against whatever the state is now.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

steps.description: Ordered list of write operations to apply in sequence

tool.description: Name of the MikroMCP tool to invoke

name: apply_plan
title: Apply Plan
